rowUnit: a mapping VIEW: one row per (direction, element, hub tuple, relation, via-relation). Rows are not edges: one graph edge can be more than one row (as 'incoming' through the hub leaf AND as 'equivalent' through another matched element), and an instanced element (SIF Question, PESC element) is ONE row for all of its instances. hubTupleSummaryList counts the edges and the elements

countUnitByField.matchedNodeCount: NODES the input matched (by name, by identifier, or by a segment of an instance context path); a SIF Question and each of its Fields are separate nodes
countUnitByField.instancePathMatchedNodeCount: NODES (instances) matched ONLY by a segment of their context path, not by name or identifier — e.g. SIF …/RaceList/Race/Code for race
countUnitByField.matchedInstanceCount: INSTANCES of this standard matched, directly or as an instance of a matched declaration
countUnitByField.matchedInstanceGroupCount: GROUPS (SIF objects / PESC sections) holding a matched instance; groupList names at most MATCHED_INSTANCE_GROUP_LIST_CAP
countUnitByField.totalRowCountByRelation: ROWS per relation; a row belongs to the relation of its weaker hop (broad/narrow, then close, else exact)
countUnitByField.totalRowCountByRelationAndStandard: ROWS per relation and source standard
countUnitByField.truncatedRowCountByRelationAndStandard: ROWS per relation and source standard not shown
countUnitByField.totalRowCountByDirection: ROWS per direction; one graph edge can appear under more than one direction
countUnitByField.declaredCorrespondenceCount: DECLARED CORRESPONDENCES touching a matched node (declaredCorrespondenceList shows at most 50): published assertions, NOT mappings, in no other total
countUnitByField.totalRowCountByHub: ROWS per hub (each row names its card's hub in hubName); rows are shown hub by hub, each hub allocated the row cap on its own
countUnitByField.hubTupleCount: HUB TUPLES (HubReferences) the rows reach; hubTupleSummaryList shows at most HUB_TUPLE_SUMMARY_CAP of them, most edges first
countUnitByField.edgeCount: EDGES: match edges in the graph into this hub tuple, each counted once, from any element (not only the matched ones)
countUnitByField.edgeCountByRelation: EDGES into this hub tuple per relation
countUnitByField.elementCount: ELEMENTS: distinct elements with a match edge into this tuple; an instanced element (SIF Question, PESC element) counts ONCE for all its instances
countUnitByField.instanceEdgeCount: EDGES into this tuple carried by instances (SIF Fields, PESC occurrences) rather than by the element itself
countUnitByField.instanceCount: INSTANCES (SIF Fields / PESC occurrences) carrying this row's verdict
countUnitByField.instanceGroupCount: GROUPS (SIF objects / PESC sections) holding those instances; instanceGroupList shows at most 25
countUnitByField.viaInstanceCount: INSTANCES of the queried element carrying the near hop's verdict

declaredCorrespondenceRowUnit: a DECLARED CORRESPONDENCE: one standard's own published assertion relating its term to another standard's (sourcePredicate quoted verbatim). NOT a mapping: never report it as EXACT/CLOSE/BROAD/NARROW, never compose it with a match edge, never count it as mapped. Its edge's mappingKind 'authored' names who published the statement: it is a published statement, never a mapping and never an 'authored mapping'
